name: 2-PYI
summary: Pyr-AI, also known as 2-pyrrolidinylindane (2-PYI), is a stimulant drug of the 2-aminoindane family. It is the analogue of 2-aminoindane (2-AI) in which the amine has been replaced with a pyrrolidine group. The drug has been described as having strong and long-lasting amphetamine-like effects in rodents. Pyr-AI was first described in the scientific literature by 1973.
